title: Tail Text Preview
description: A client-side mod that provides a convenient graphical user interface (GUI) for real-time preview of Minecraft text formatting, including colors, styles, and gradients.
body:
# Tail Text Preview — Real-time Minecraft Text Formatting

### **Мод полностью поддерживает русский язык! [Подробнее на русском](https://github.com/KitsuByte/Tail-Text-Preview/blob/main/README_RU.md)**

Tail Text Preview is a client-side Minecraft mod that provides a convenient GUI for creating and previewing formatted text in real time.

Instead of manually guessing color codes and formatting styles, you can type your text, apply colors or styles, preview the result, and copy the generated formatting code for use in commands, signs, books, or other supported text fields.

## Key Features

- **Live Preview**  
  Preview formatted Minecraft text in real time as you edit.

- **Quick Formatting & Styles**  
  Apply standard Minecraft colors  and formatting styles (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, obfuscated) through a simple visual interface.

- **Advanced Template Manager (Sidebar)**  
  Organize and manage your drafts easily:
  - **Folders & Categories:** Group templates into expandable/collapsible folders. Templates without a folder sit cleanly at the root level.
  - **Drag & Drop:** Reorder templates, move them between folders, or drag folders to sort them.
  - **Dynamic Resizing:** Drag the sidebar border to adjust its width.
  - **Status Indicators:** Text colors indicate when a template has unsaved changes (orange) or is saved (green).
  - **Marquee Effect:** Long template or folder names automatically scroll for readability.

- **Interactive Tooltips & Shortcuts**  
  Hover over elements for quick hotkey and usage hints. Can be toggled on/off in the Settings menu.

- **One-Click Copy & Restore**  
  Copy formatted text with a single click. Right-click a template to discard unsaved edits and restore its saved state.

- **Undo and Redo**  
  Use `Ctrl+Z` and `Ctrl+Y` to undo or redo text changes, and `Ctrl+S` to save template edits instantly.

## Who is this for?

Tail Text Preview is useful for:
- Server administrators creating announcements, ranks, messages, or commands
- Map makers designing books, signs, titles, and custom text
- Datapack or command creators working with formatted Minecraft text
- Players looking for a simple way to prepare styled chat messages

## Client-Side Only

Tail Text Preview is a client-side mod. It does not need to be installed on the server. 

*Note: Whether formatted text works in a specific place still depends on Minecraft limitations, server permissions, plugins, or the text field where the output is used.*

## Requirements

- **Loader:** Fabric Loader
- **Dependencies:** Fabric API
- **Java:** 17 or newer
